slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

asking for directions

ask a stranger for directions once a week, even when you know the way. small, harmless asks slowly rewire the fear of needing people.

the two second pause

when someone asks your opinion, wait two full seconds before answering. people who don't rush to fill silence look like they've already thought it through.

handwritten letters

write one handwritten letter a month to someone who shaped you, and actually send it. saying the true thing on paper makes saying it out loud so much easier.

a lesson a day

learn one small thing every morning before opening social media: a battle, a word in another language, a fact about space. 5 minutes a day is almost 30 hours of knowledge a year.
slides.texte_sophia:
a lesson a day

learn one small thing every morning before opening social media. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app gives you a 5 minute lesson on history, art or science. that's almost 30 hours of knowledge a year.

slides.texte_overlay:
empty handed walking

walk somewhere with nothing in your hands. no phone, no coffee, no bag. people who don't need something to hold look like they own the space.
